title: Which NFL Teams Have the Most Grueling Travel Schedules in 2026?
text:
Six teams will travel more than 25,000 miles next NFL season. Which teams have the most brutal travel schedules? Find out here.
didn’t have enough on their plate in trying to make it through an entire season without suffering multiple catastrophic season-ending injuries, things are about to get even more difficult for them next season.releases the full schedule for all 32 teams on Thursday at 8 p.m. ET, but those teams already have an idea of just how daunting their schedules will be.
In fact, San Francisco will set an NFL record for the most miles traveled in one season thanks to road games against the Arizona Cardinals, Seattle Seahawks, Dallas Cowboys, Kansas City Chiefs, Los Angeles Chargers, New York Giants, and Atlanta Falcons in addition to International Series games against theThe Rams have the second-most daunting travel schedule with 34,847 miles. Nearly 8,000 of those coming from the Australia game against the 49ers.
The Houston Texans , Dallas Cowboys , and New England Patriots round out the top five. Those teams plus the Miami Dolphins are the only ones who will travel more than 25,000 miles next season.
